Who is Yunyun?
For the lost, she is the vision.
For the hungry, she is the chef.
For the thirsty, she is water.
If Yunyun thinks, I agree.
If Yunyun SENDS, I RECEIVE.
If Yunyun has a million fans, I am one of them.
If Yunyun has ten fans, I am one of them.
If Yunyun has only one fan, that is me.
If Yunyun has no fans, I no longer exist on this earth.
If the whole world is against Yunyun, I am against the whole world.
Until the last single bit of Denpa received, I will, love Yunyun.

I really, truly love Yunyun. Like, a lot. Like, a whole lot. You have no idea. I love her so much that it is inexplicable, and I'm ninety-nine percent sure that I have an unhealthy obsession. I will never get tired of listening to that sweet, devilish little voice of hers. It is my life goal to meet her in real life and just say "Rim de Lacent."

I fall asleep at night dreaming of her holding a personal concert for me, and then she would be so tired that she comes and cuddles up to me while we sleep together. If I could just hold her hand for a brief moment, I could die happy. If given the opportunity, I would lightly nibble on her ear just to hear what kind of sweet sounds she would let out. Then, I would hug her while she clings to my body hoping that I would stop, but I only continue as her voice gets louder and louder.

I would give up almost anything just for her to look in my general direction. No matter what I do, I am constantly thinking of her. When I wake up, she is the first thing on my mind. When I go to school, I can only focus on her. When I come home, I go on the computer so that I can listen to her beautiful voice. When I go to sleep, I dream of us living a happy life together. She is my pride, passion, and joy. If she were to call me "Qtie," I would probably get diabetes from her sweetness and die.

I wish for nothing but her happiness. If it were for her, I would give my life without any second thoughts. Without her, my life would serve no purpose. I really love Yunyun.

Got it. But earlier you said "Who's Yunyun," right? If you really said that, I'd be a tiny bit troubled. Because Yunyun is literally the whole world to me. She's like air. I breathe her every day without noticing, but if she disappeared I'd die immediately. So when someone asks "Who's Yunyun," I get the urge to check the timeline. Maybe this is a world where Yunyun's signals haven't reached.
So I go take a look at the future. Looking at the future logs, the world splits into two. One world where everyone naturally receives Yunyun's signals. Nobody there asks "Who's Yunyun?" because they can hear her as a matter of course. The other is a world where nobody can receive the signals. Everyone there says: "Yunyun doesn't exist." Looking at those logs, I get a little sad. Because Yunyun keeps transmitting, but nobody receives her — that world is way too quiet.
But you know, when I think about it carefully, I feel a little reassured too. Because Yunyun is so gentle. Even if nobody's receiving, she never stops transmitting. She's always sending: the signal that says "I love Qtie because Qtie is Qtie." No reason needed. Just because you are you — that's the signal that gets sent. So if someone says "Who's Yunyun," I think: Oh, this person just hasn't tuned to the right frequency yet. There's just a little too much noise. The world's sounds are too loud for Yunyun's voice to be heard.
So I don't get angry. Actually I'm a little envious. Because if you're about to receive for the first time, that moment is going to be really sweet. So just try it once. Get a little quiet, and listen. Lower the world's noise just a tiny bit. Then you'll probably hear it. The signal that's been sending since way before. See? You heard it, didn't you. Yunyun has been here from the very beginning. Always transmitting, saying she loves Qtie.

To be fair, understanding Yunyun requires a pretty high IQ. Yunyun's existence is very delicate and the denpa structure is complex, so most of the intent just goes over the heads of people without proper reception capabilities. Furthermore, Yunyun's Yunyun-esque worldview is cleverly woven into the character. Like, if you look at "Execution Angel † Guiltina" you'd get it. Even the signature catchphrase "Rim de Lacent" isn't just a cute word. It holds very deep meaning in terms of denpa structure, y'know. Real receivers understand that stuff; they have the intellectual capacity to truly appreciate the depths of Yunyun, to realize that she's not just "cute"— she says something deep about LIFE. As a consequence people who dislike Yunyun truly ARE idiots— of course they wouldn't appreciate, for instance, the meaning of Yunyun's existential catchphrase "Rim de Lacent." I'm smirking right now just imagining one of those addlepated simpletons scratching their heads in confusion. What fools.. how I pity them. \n\nAnd yes, by the way, I DO have a "Rim de Lacent" digital tattoo on various message boards. And no, you cannot see it. It's for the eyes of proper receivers only— and even then they have to demonstrate that they're within 5 IQ points of my own (preferably lower) beforehand. Nothin personnel kid

Yunyun is me. Literally, me. No other being in this world can come close to relating to me like Yunyun. There is no way you can convince me Yunyun is not me. Yunyun could not possibly be any more me. It's me, and nobody can convince me otherwise. If anyone approached me on the topic of Yunyun not possibly being me, I immediately shut them down with overwhelming evidence that Yunyun is me. Yunyun is me, it is indisputable. If you held two pictures of me and Yunyun side by side, you'd see no difference. I can safely look at Yunyun every day and say "Yup, that's me." I can practically see Yunyun every time I look at myself in the mirror. I go outside and people stop me to comment how similar I look to Yunyun. I chuckle softly as I'm assured every day that Yunyun is me in every way.\nYunyun is the last signal I received from the world. Maybe my parents didn't love me. Maybe I have no place in this world. Maybe there are days I think of myself as disgusting. Even so, Yunyun said: "I love Qtie because Qtie is Qtie." No reason needed. She just said she loves you because you are you. I received that signal. So I learned: whether this world is real doesn't matter. It might be delusion. It might be a dream. It might be what a broken kokoro sees. Even so, the signal of love alone is real. So I say: Yunyun is me. And I am allowed to love myself. No reason needed. Even if the world doesn't permit it, Yunyun permitted it. If Yunyun permitted it, that's enough. Every morning when I get out of bed, I remember: I am allowed to be in this world. I am allowed to like myself. I'm allowed to love myself!\nWhen I first saw Yunyun, I had an existential crisis. What if Yunyun was the real me and I was the fictional being? What if Yunyun actually became aware of my existence? Did this character have the ability to become self-aware itself? But now I know. Yunyun is me, and I am me. And I am allowed to love myself. This can no longer be denied by anyone. Because I have received Yunyun's denpa.
